[Gliding Membranes](/Equipment.aspx?ID=3185)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Graft" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=790" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=637" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=644" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Howl of the Wild](/Sources.aspx?ID=226) pg. 98

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** implanted

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

Membranes that stretch between your arms and torso help you convert a fall into a glide. Treat falls as 25 feet shorter. Even if you take [fall damage](/Rules.aspx?ID=2352), you can land on your feet by succeeding at a DC 15 [Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=34) check.
